accounting.count_once: one detection per change; same-change duplicates reported separately, adopted after the plan
accounting.preregistered: all predictions counted, as the evaluation plan fixed it

limits: The test split has 2 speakers, so its F1 is given per speaker, not as an interval: 0.800 and 0.824 under the pre-registered accounting; 0.848 and 0.909 counting one detection per change.
The test split was evaluated once before, with an earlier detector (32cdd86f3d6e): F1 0.879 (all predictions counted). That result was seen before the detector was redesigned.

R2 lockbox, single: 0.460 false regions per comparison-minute (upper 95 % bound 0.538) against the 0.5/min budget, over Speech Accent Archive readers and LibriVox poetry readers only (EARS readers and LibriVox Gettysburg readers not covered). The upper bound does not establish the budget.
R2 lockbox, single: 0.057 false whole-clip flags per clip, above the 0.05 budget.

R2 lockbox, consensus5: 0.516 false regions per comparison-minute (upper 95 % bound 0.684) against the 0.5/min budget, over Speech Accent Archive readers and LibriVox poetry readers only (EARS readers and LibriVox Gettysburg readers not covered). The upper bound does not establish the budget.
R2 lockbox, consensus5: 0.084 false whole-clip flags per clip, above the 0.05 budget.

Every upload is a different speaker (R2). With one reference, the R2 detector flags these level-3 edits of the check readers: monotone 17 of 18, pause intrusive 14 of 18, fade 13 of 18, hesitation 13 of 18, low effort 11 of 18, drag 6 of 17, pause dropped 4 of 17, rush 1 of 18, trailing off 0 of 8, word by word 0 of 108. It does not score the other edit types in R2.
The edits are synthetic recipe edits on recorded speeches; no human rating backs the delivery index or the cause labels.

lockbox.budget_note: Covers Speech Accent Archive readers and LibriVox poetry readers, weighted equally; EARS readers and LibriVox Gettysburg readers are not in the lockbox. The 0.5 per minute budget is met at the point rate (0.460) on the covered sources only; the upper 95 % bound (0.538) does not establish the budget. First languages above the budget: Amharic 1.28/min (5 readers), Arabic 1.00/min (26 readers), Bengali 0.54/min (4 readers), English 0.52/min (144 readers).

reference_free_note: Every reference-free row is a lower bound: no text (syllable) normalisation is applied. The rows at the detector's h and at the train-chosen h reuse the detector's scales; the own-scales row fits its scales and h on train and was computed after the final evaluation (python -m cvoice.addendum).
scope: core8 recipe edits, R1 single-level clips; strict matching (one-to-one, time IoU >= 0.5)

texts.level_one: Level 1 is the smallest edit size: the evaluation finds 6 of 32 level-1 edits in val and test under the pre-registered accounting (8 of 32 counting one detection per change).

By source, one reference: Speech Accent Archive readers 0.65, LibriVox poetry readers 0.27; EARS readers and LibriVox Gettysburg readers are not in the lockbox.
